skills.name: om-brainstorm
skills.question: Is this idea worth building?
skills.outcome: Compare ways to solve the problem and decide what to try first.
skills.prompt: Store managers want a weekly sales email. Help me decide whether an email would improve their current routine.
skills.label: Explore an idea

skills.name: om-discover
skills.question: Who has this problem?
skills.outcome: Turn interview notes into a product brief. Record the evidence and the questions you still need to ask.
skills.prompt: Read these store interviews. Who copies orders into a spreadsheet, and what do they use it for?
skills.label: Understand the user

skills.name: om-synthetic-users
skills.question: Where might someone get stuck?
skills.outcome: Walk the same flow with simulated users based on interview material. Repeated difficulties are questions to check with real users.
skills.prompt: Walk the Friday export flow with store-manager personas drawn from these interviews. List questions for our next store visit.
skills.label: Walk the flow with personas

skills.name: om-ux-shape
skills.question: Which interaction should we try?
skills.outcome: Choose a direction, sketch the states and decide which assumption to test first.
skills.prompt: Should managers export the current list or configure a separate report? Use the interview notes to choose a flow to test.
skills.label: Shape the interaction

skills.name: om-mockup-prototype
skills.question: Can we try the flow before writing the spec?
skills.outcome: Build a low-fidelity, clickable flow from the brief and first persona walkthrough. Use it to test decisions, then update the brief with what the team learned.
skills.prompt: Use the export brief and first walkthrough to prototype choosing a filter and downloading orders. Include the empty-list state.
skills.label: Build a clickable prototype

skills.name: om-ux-design
skills.question: What should the approved flow look like?
skills.outcome: Design the connected screens from a spec or selected backlog scope. Reuse the project’s components and check the relevant states in a browser.
skills.prompt: Design the export flow from the agreed spec. Use the existing order list and show the empty and permission-denied states.
skills.label: Design the screens

skills.name: om-app-spec-writing
skills.question: What belongs in the spec for the whole app?
skills.outcome: Define the business workflows, data model and rollout. Break the approved app spec into briefs for individual features.
skills.prompt: Write an app spec for store reporting. Cover who owns orders, who reads reports and which workflow to ship first.
skills.label: Define the app

skills.name: om-spec-writing
skills.question: How do I turn a tested flow into a feature spec?
skills.outcome: Use the updated brief and prototype walkthrough to write the behavior, permissions and acceptance tests. Record any decision the walkthrough left open.
skills.prompt: Draft the export spec from this brief and prototype. Keep the agreed filter behavior. Ask who may download orders across stores.
skills.label: Write the feature spec

skills.name: om-pre-implement-spec
skills.question: Is the spec ready to build?
skills.outcome: Check for missing decisions and compatibility issues. The result is a readiness assessment and a list of gaps.
skills.prompt: Review the export spec. Can a developer tell what happens when the order list is empty?
skills.label: Check a spec

skills.name: om-backlog
skills.question: How do we split the work?
skills.outcome: Turn a ready brief or phased spec into stories with acceptance criteria. Preview the backlog before filing issues.
skills.prompt: Preview the backlog for the export spec. Split file generation, permissions and the download action into reviewable tasks.
skills.label: Break the spec into tasks

skills.name: om-implement-spec
skills.question: Can we build the agreed scope?
skills.outcome: Implement a spec or one of its phases, run the tests and record progress in the spec.
skills.prompt: Implement the first phase of the export spec. Check the sample file against the acceptance criteria.
skills.label: Build from a spec

skills.name: om-auto-create-pr
skills.question: Can the agent take this through to review?
skills.outcome: Give the agent a task. It plans the work, implements it, runs checks and opens a pull request for review.
skills.prompt: Add a status filter to the order list. Test it and open a pull request.
skills.label: Open a pull request

skills.name: om-verify-in-repo
skills.question: Does this report still apply?
skills.outcome: Check the current code and look for an existing fix before assigning the bug.
skills.prompt: Check issue 123 against the current branch. Does the export still ignore the status filter?
skills.label: Verify a report

skills.name: om-root-cause
skills.question: We reproduced the bug. What causes it?
skills.outcome: Trace the failure to the code that causes it and identify the smallest change that would fix it.
skills.prompt: Trace the confirmed failure in issue 123. Where does the export lose the status filter?
skills.label: Find the cause

skills.name: om-fix
skills.question: We know the cause. Can we fix it?
skills.outcome: Apply the diagnosed fix, add a regression test and run the project checks.
skills.prompt: Apply the fix from the diagnosis for issue 123. Add a test for exporting a filtered list.
skills.label: Apply a fix

skills.name: om-smart-test
skills.question: Which tests cover this change?
skills.outcome: Run the tests affected by the diff. If the mapping is uncertain, run the full suite.
skills.prompt: Run the tests affected by the order export changes on this branch.
skills.label: Run affected tests

skills.name: om-code-review
skills.question: Could this change break existing behavior?
skills.outcome: Inspect the diff for bugs, security issues and changes to existing behavior. Findings are ranked by severity.
skills.prompt: Review the export diff. Check access rules and what happens when no orders match.
skills.label: Review the code

skills.name: om-qa-buddy
skills.question: How do I check this in the app?
skills.outcome: Work through a manual test plan with the agent and record what actually happens.
skills.prompt: Walk me through the export as a store manager, then as someone without export access.
skills.label: Test in the app

phases.name: Discover
phases.title: Why did the Friday report take so long?
phases.agent: Matched interview notes to the Friday spreadsheet.
phases.human: Chose paid orders from the manager’s store.
phases.result: First prototype: one filter and a download.

phases.name: Prototype
phases.title: Would the filtered list be enough?
phases.agent: Built a clickable list of orders.
phases.human: Tried a Friday with no sales.
phases.result: What should the empty export contain?

phases.name: Specify
phases.title: What should an empty export contain?
phases.agent: Drafted tests for both filter results.
phases.human: Kept the same headers in both files.
phases.result: A sample for the empty state.

phases.name: Design
phases.title: Where would a manager look for the file?
phases.agent: Placed the download beside the filters.
phases.human: Approved the action on the order list.
phases.result: The existing list supplies the filters.

phases.name: Build
phases.title: Which rows should the button download?
phases.agent: Connected the order query to CSV.
phases.human: Kept the same permissions as the order list.
phases.result: Next test: two accounts with different access.

phases.name: Verify
phases.title: Could someone download another store’s orders?
phases.agent: Checked the filter and download permissions.
phases.human: Compared each account’s file with its order list.

phases.name: Release
phases.title: Was the export ready for Friday?
phases.agent: Picked an order with a known amount.
phases.human: Deployed the change and checked the live file.
phases.result: The manager can use the export this Friday.

phases.name: Observe
phases.title: What still took time on Friday?
phases.agent: Compared the file with the reporting sheet.
phases.human: Spotted one manual step: rearranging columns.
phases.result: Next interview: which column order works?
